swiss-case-index: The expanded Lattice panel must not leave a blank gap. On desktop, about 600px of empty white sits between the FIG. 01 caption and row 02. On mobile, about 950px of empty white sits below the 'Lattice Design System' h2. Set the expanded panel's height to its content (height:auto, no min-height). The space between the caption and the next row's hairline must be 48px or less.

On mobile, the expanded project must show its full content: meta row, description, figure and caption. Right now only the h2 renders. Never hide expanded content with opacity:0, a fixed height or a failed fade-up. The meta row must stack as label/value pairs, and the figure must fill the 12-column width at the same aspect ratio as on desktop.

The figure diagram must not clip or overflow. In the 'Tokens' box, the text 'Style Dictionary' runs past the right border and under the arrow. Set the box text to 14px or smaller in mono, with padding of 16px or more. Add overflow-wrap:anywhere. Make the box wide enough that no text crosses a 1px border.

Remove the decorative diagram, or replace it with a real project image. The Tokens → Components → Teams boxes use 2px dark strokes and arrow icons. They break the rule 'no decorative illustration or icons' and the hairline-only rule. Use an uncropped image in a hairline frame at a fixed 16:9 ratio. Place a mono caption below it. Do not use 2px strokes or arrows.

The empty ABOUT and CONTACT sections must contain content, or they must be removed. Each has only a gray label above 100px or more of blank space. Put a body paragraph in ABOUT and the email in CONTACT, aligned to the same column as the hero text (column 4 on desktop). Alternatively, delete both sections and keep their nav links as anchors to real content.

Keep the column grid consistent. The hero headline starts at x≈316 (display scale), but the expanded h2 and figure start at x≈140. The row meta columns are at 492, 669, 845 and 1022. The expanded meta row uses 140, 404 and 669. Snap all blocks to the same 12-column lines. Meta cells in the expanded panel must start at the same x as the ROLE, TOOLS and OUTPUT columns in the row above.

Fix the type scale and the contrast. Use at most three sizes: for example 56px for the hero, 32px for the project h2, and 12–14px for everything else. The mono meta text in the header and footer is about 11px at #999 on white (about 2.8:1 contrast). Use #666 or darker for text that is 14px or smaller. Keep #999 for hairlines and decorative labels only.

Make the nav and the toggles clear and aligned. On desktop the nav (WORK/ABOUT/CONTACT) is centered in the bar, and 'CLOSE'/'OPEN' sit loose at the end of each row. On mobile the nav is crammed next to the logo. Left-align the nav to a grid column. Label each toggle with a 44px-tall hit area. Use #ff3300 only on the active row's number marker or on hover, with a transition of 150ms or less (linear).
